source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 31 May 1961, p. 20 ("Notice of result of elections: Hillsborough Rural District")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the returning officer’s notice of result in the Belfast Telegraph of 31 May 1961.

note: Triennial election of Hillsborough Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Sixteen candidates were returned unopposed for sixteen seats. Addresses and occupations printed with the names are not reproduced (privacy rule; gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Ballyworphy' to Ballyworfy (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Hillsborough Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Ballyworfy; the rounds were filed as Ballyworfy (1924, 1930, 1933, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1967); Ballyworphy (1927, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1958, 1961, 1964). This round was filed as 'Ballyworphy', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (ballyworphy) answers with a redirect to this one.
